title: PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust to Present at the Barclays 24th Annual Global Financial Services Conference
summary: WESTLAKE VILLAGE, Calif., September 08, 2026--PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust (NYSE: PMT) announced today that it will present jointly with PennyMac Financial Services, Inc. (NYSE: PFSI) at the Barclays 24th Annual Global Financial Services Conference. Chairman and Chief Executive Officer David Spector and Senior Managing Director and Chief Financial Officer Daniel Perotti will participate in a fireside chat at 9:45 a.m. Eastern Time on Tuesday, September 15, 2026.

title: PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust Declares Third Quarter 2026 Dividend for Its Common Shares
summary: WESTLAKE VILLAGE, Calif., September 02, 2026--PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust (NYSE: PMT) announced today that its Board of Trustees declared a cash dividend of $0.40 per common share of beneficial interest for the third quarter of 2026. This dividend will be paid on October 23, 2026, to common shareholders of record as of October 8, 2026.
